description:
An existing complaint case titled 'Public Records Request - Water Quality Data' is currently assigned to user 'arkcase-admin'. Due to workload rebalancing, this case needs to be reassigned to user 'sally-acm' (Sally Acm).

Steps:
1. Find the case number in the file /tmp/complaint_case_number.txt
2. Navigate to that complaint case in ArkCase (you can use the case number or search for the title)
3. Open the case details
4. Change the Assignee from 'arkcase-admin' to 'sally-acm' (Sally Acm)
5. Save the changes

The ArkCase application is already open in Firefox and you are logged in as the administrator. The case number is stored in /tmp/complaint_case_number.txt for reference.

IMPORTANT: Only change the assignee field. Do not modify any other case properties (title, status, priority, etc.).
